54/* @brief Observation state (empty — this controller is target-driven). */
55struct ControllerMochiArticulatedPoseObsv {};

57/* @brief Target to drive the ArticulatedPoseController toward.
58 * Provide exactly one of localToParentTransforms or poseDofs. */
59struct ControllerMochiArticulatedPoseTarget {
60 TransformRT worldFromRoot = TransformRT::Identity(); /* Root link pose in world frame */
61 DynamicArray<TransformRT> localToParentTransforms; /* Per-link LocalToParent transforms */
62 DynamicArray<real> poseDofs; /* Non-root joint DOFs; root DOFs are derived from worldFromRoot */
63};

65/* @brief ControllerMochiArticulatedPose -- drives a mochi ArticulatedPoseController
66 * via either per-link LocalToParent transforms (converted to world-space targets)
67 * or non-root pose DOFs combined with a world-space root transform. */
68
69// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
70class MOCHI_API ControllerMochiArticulatedPose : public ControllerBase {
71 public:
72 /* @brief Registration type name for this controller (see
73 * RoboticsContext::RegisterControllerType).
74 * @return This controller's registration type name. */
75 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
76 return "MOCHI_ARTICULATED_POSE";
77 }
78
79 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
80 return TypeName();
81 }
82
83 using Params = ControllerMochiArticulatedPoseParams;
84 using Obsv = ControllerMochiArticulatedPoseObsv;
85 using Target = ControllerMochiArticulatedPoseTarget;
86
87 /* @brief Construct an ArticulatedPoseController for the given articulated robot, optionally
88 * holding a borrowed robot-model description (see GetBotPrefab).
89 * @param prefab Optional borrowed BotPrefab model (may be null; must outlive the controller).
90 * @param robot The articulated robot actor to control.
91 * @param error Error status. */
92 ControllerMochiArticulatedPose(BotPrefab const* prefab, Actor* robot, superdex::Error& error);
93
94 /* This controller owns a singleton ArticulatedPoseController registration on the
95 * actor (removed in the destructor), so it is neither copyable nor movable. */
96 ControllerMochiArticulatedPose(ControllerMochiArticulatedPose const&) = delete;
97 ControllerMochiArticulatedPose& operator=(ControllerMochiArticulatedPose const&) = delete;
98 ControllerMochiArticulatedPose(ControllerMochiArticulatedPose&&) = delete;
99 ControllerMochiArticulatedPose& operator=(ControllerMochiArticulatedPose&&) = delete;
100
101 /* @brief Add a mochi ArticulatedPoseController to the actor using the default/current params.
102 * Mochi ArticulatedPoseController is a singleton per articulation so only one controller can be
103 * active at a time. Calling commands on multiple controllers at the same time will result in
104 * overwriting commands. Must be called after SetParams and before ComputeOutput.
105 * @param removeExisting If true, removes any existing ArticulatedPoseController on the actor
106 * before adding a new one. If false, an existing controller causes an error.
107 * @param error Error status. */
108 void Initialize(bool removeExisting, superdex::Error& error);
109
110 /* @brief Get controller parameters.
111 * @return The params. */
112 [[nodiscard]] Params const& GetParams() const;
113
114 /* @brief Set controller parameters.
115 * @param params Params.
116 * @param error Error status. */
117 void SetParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
118
119 /* @brief Configure from a scene entry: load params (if @p paramArgs is non-empty), then add the
120 * pose controller to the actor so it is ready to receive targets. Override of ControllerBase. */
121 void ConfigureFromSceneEntry(
122 std::string_view paramArgs,
123 std::string_view initArgs,
124 superdex::Error& error) override;
125
126 /* @brief Forward targets to the internal pose controller.
127 * @param obsv Unused (empty).
128 * @param target Target poses: either worldFromRoot + localToParentTransforms (link transforms
129 * path) or worldFromRoot + poseDofs (pose DOFs path). Exactly one must be provided.
130 * @param error Error status.
131 * @return Empty span — control is applied internally via the pose controller. */
132 Span<real const> ComputeOutput(Obsv const& obsv, Target const& target, superdex::Error& error);
133
134 /* @brief Reset internal controller state (e.g., between episodes). */
135 void Reset() override;
136
137 protected:
138 Params _params;
139
140 int _numLinks = 0;
141 DynamicArray<int> _parentIndices;
142
143 DynamicArray<TransformRT> _worldFromLinks;
144
145 int _rootTransDofsCount = 0;
146 int _rootRotDofsCount = 0;
147 int _totalDofCount = 0;
148 DynamicArray<real> _combinedDofs;
149
150 bool _poseControllerAdded = false;
151 bool _needsReset = true;
152 bool _hasUserParams = false;
153
154 ~ControllerMochiArticulatedPose() override;
155};
